title: Licht und Farbe
slide_intent: Use available directional light without turning effects into the subject so images retain credibility.
strategic_value: Natural contrast and controlled signal colors can give DB scenes depth while preserving realism.
demonstration: A preferred collage shows directed light on interiors and people; two crossed-out images illustrate dramatic backlight and cinematic effects.
practical_value: Use light edges, natural shadows and neutral base tones; avoid extreme backlighting and artificial color amplification.

content_islands.name: Lighting and color guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the neutral-base and warm-accent explanation above the preferred collage.

content_islands.name: Preferred scenes
content_islands.spec: Show natural directed light in seating, portrait and doorway images.

content_islands.name: Rejected effects
content_islands.spec: Place the Don’t explanation above two crossed-out dramatic-light examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says directional light reveals structure and gives depth.
reference_purposes.Application: Preferred and rejected examples distinguish natural contrast from cinematic staging.
reference_purposes.Constraint: No extreme backlight, artificial strip lighting or overdramatic light; DB Red and safety orange are controlled rather than artificially intensified.

ingredient.name: DB photographic light and color
ingredient.role: Reveal structure and preserve believable atmosphere.
ingredient.application: Use directed natural light, differentiated neutral color and controlled warm or signal accents.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Avoid cinematic light effects and artificially intensified signal colors.
